source_refs.note: i) Stem or Root: a main subheading of 19.4 Nomenclature of Aliphatic Organic Compounds, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 41-41.

blocks.text: Stem sab se lambi continuous (lagataar) carbon chain batata hai jis mein functional group wala carbon bhi shamil ho. Functional group wale carbon ko sab se chhota possible number diya jata hai. Agar carbon atoms ring mein jure hon to naam “cyclo” se shuru hota hai.
